description: Bounded replay of the centralized GOC-MCDS-C maximal-independent-set and distance-four connector stages.

source.title: Routing-Cost Constrained Connected Dominating Set
source.algorithm_attribution: Centralized GOC-MCDS-C connector stage with the cited unique-ID MISI rule as its deterministic maximal-independent-set selector
source.implementation_status: clean-room bounded trace; deterministic ID and shortest-path tie rules

cited_primary_work.title: CDS-based virtual backbone construction with guaranteed routing cost in wireless sensor networks
cited_primary_work.journal: IEEE Transactions on Parallel and Distributed Systems

input.adjacency_masks: symmetric loop-free masks over vertices 0..n-1; graph must be connected
input.node_ids: distinct positive IDs used by MISI and shortest-path tie breaking

workspace.meaning: Fixed adjacency, BFS, queue, and set-mask state for at most eight vertices.

contract.stage_one: Construct a maximal independent set with the published unique-ID synchronous MISI rounds: every white vertex with the smallest ID among its white neighbors turns black; white neighbors of black vertices turn gray.
contract.stage_two: For each MIS pair at graph distance at most four, add the internal vertices of one shortest path to the connector set.
contract.shortest_path_tie_rule: Among shortest paths, choose the lexicographically smallest node-ID sequence; consider MIS pairs in ascending node-ID order.
contract.result: Return the MIS mask and the union of the MIS and all selected path interiors.
contract.scope: The chapter's unit-disk approximation and routing-stretch guarantees are not claimed for this graph-only profile; distributed Algorithm 3 is excluded.
